verdict.rationale: Postmark's Templates API supports creating, editing, listing, and validating templates, plus pushing templates between servers (versioning-like workflow), and sending by template alias/id via /email/withTemplate and batch variants with variable payloads (TemplateModel). Docs also show TypeScript examples using TemplateAlias and TemplateModel for structured sends. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of template CRUD or template-based sends, and no explicit mention of true version history/rollback for templates beyond push-to-server.
